bias.en: Downtrend · lost the 200-day and the Jul 29 low
bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 跌破 200 日均线和 7月29日低点

read.en: Micron fell 17.5% on Nov 5 to $656.39, trading between $650.00 and $761.81 on volume nearly three times its 20-day average. It closed below the rising 200-day ($755.3) and is under the falling 5-day ($805.0), 10-day ($865.3), 30-day ($953.0) and 100-day ($962.7) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 30 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($975.57), and RSI is 27.
read.zh: 美光 11月5日下跌 17.5%，收于 $656.39，盘中区间 $650.00–761.81，成交量接近 20 日均量的三倍。收盘跌破上行的 200 日均线（$755.3），并位于下行的 5 日（$805.0）、10 日（$865.3）、30 日（$953.0）和 100 日均线（$962.7）下方。MACD 自 10月30日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$975.57），RSI 为 27。

read.en: The close broke the $782 Nov 4 low, the 200-day and the $737.9 Jul 29 low; the $761.81 high stalled just above the 200-day. Resistance is $737.9–761.8 (Jul 29 low, 200-day, Nov 5 high), then $782–795 (Nov 4 low and close) and $804–818.7. Support is $650–652.2 (Nov 5 low, May 19 low), then $600–605.5 (round number, May 5 low) and $557.8 (May 4 low). A close above $761.8 would target $782–795; below $650, $605.
